name: Sunlit Sentinel
card_text: You can Set this card from your hand to your Spell & Trap Zone as a Spell. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase of the next turn after this Set card was destroyed and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon this card, then destroy all cards your opponent controls in this card's column.
available_set: 25TH ANNIVERSARY TIN: DUELING HEROES MEGA PACK
